scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run lint:style && POSTMAN_GYM_DATA_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" tsx --test '{shared,server}/src/**/*.test.ts' && npm run test -w web
